The 15.24 mm square body for one gate leaves its lower-left quarter empty, so it is roomier than needed. That costs a point but stays at the bar.

wiring_ergonomics.note: ERGONOMICS 4: A enters left and Y leaves right on the same row (y=+2.54), so arena wires run straight through. nOE drops from the bottom centre as a full-length pin on the 100-mil grid (trap 6). All pin ends sit at +/-12.7 or -10.16. Two-digit numbers 10 and 13 sit clear of the lead and body (trap 9). On unit 5, VCC on the left and GND at the bottom both wire cleanly to the rail labels.

expressibility.note: EXPRESSIBILITY 4: the 3-state mark (Fig. 2), the active-low bubble and bar (Fig. 1) and the Z-state caption (Table 3) state the whole function table without opening the datasheet. The A to Y direction gives nY = nA, and the channel digits keep the four gates apart.
